message.content:
Quick prep brief
Purpose of the meeting
The session is to kick off enhancements review and sizing for Sprint 2, specifically to check whether the team has enough information from the**“Must Have” tickets** and decide what can be reviewed/sized now versus what needs further clarification.
Review priority
[Re: [Review] Enhancements & Sizing](https://outlook.office365.com/owa/?ItemID=AAMkADAwMDY5M2RlLWQ4YTgtNDk0ZC05NjE0LWY5NDM4ODY2NjlmYwBGAAAAAADj6PLKElMiQqCITvdyZx6EBwBDVw5BF5KXS4J9nmOzC999AAAAAAEMAABDVw5BF5KXS4J9nmOzC999AAAe0PAnAAA%3d&exvsurl=1&viewmodel=ReadMessageItem&EntityRepresentationId=0acdfd83-0979-4cb1-a0eb-f17f8d59b5b0) says the meeting will review the https://zimmermannworkboard.atlassian.net/browse/SFCC-24?search_id=8285876f-f3cc-436f-9943-85be8017d2e1 in this order: Must Have’s not yet sized first, then Should Have’s, then Could Have’s.
What you should have ready
Come in with a sizing lens across these effort areas: BA effort, QA / SIT effort, Front End effort if any, Back End effort if any, and Architecture effort if any.
Given your frontend lead role on Zimmermann, I’d focus your prep on this simple mental model:

For each enhancement:
1. Is there any Front End impact?
2. Is the requirement clear enough to size?
3. Does it touch PWA Kit / React, Contentful, SFCC integration, checkout, account, PDP/PLP, or CMS-rendered areas?
4. Are there design/Figma dependencies?
5. Are there API/backend dependencies?
6. Is this a pure FE change, shared FE/BE change, or needs architecture input?
7. Can we size now, or do we need clarification?

Suggested stance for the meeting
You can frame your input like this:

For FE sizing, I’ll separate the tickets into:
- Clear enough to size now
- Needs design clarification
- Needs API/backend clarification
- Needs architecture decision
- No obvious FE impact
For anything touching UI, I’ll also call out whether the designs/design system are mature enough for us to size confidently, or whether we need assumptions documented before committing.

Questions worth asking
Use these if the discussion gets fuzzy:

* “Do we have enough acceptance criteria to size this, or should this go into clarification first?”
* “Is the expected UI already covered in Figma, or are we sizing based on assumptions?”
* “Is this enhancement purely frontend, or does it need backend/API support?”
* “Are we sizing implementation only, or also discovery/spike effort?”
* “Should we capture assumptions separately so the estimate doesn’t look more certain than it is?”
* “For Must Haves, do we need a minimum viable implementation for Sprint 2, or the full desired enhancement?”

Quick sizing template you can use live

Ticket:
Priority: Must / Should / Could
FE impact: Yes / No / Unknown
FE estimate:
BE dependency:
QA/SIT consideration:
Design dependency:
Architecture input needed: Yes / No
Clarifications required:
Sizing confidence: High / Medium / Low
Recommendation: Size now / Clarify first / Spike needed

People context
Required invitees include [Linsangan, Gideon R.](https://www.office.com/search?q=Linsangan%2c+Gideon+R.&EntityRepresentationId=a09dcabc-7f11-42fd-a47a-081c6e8e53ba), [Navarro, Marcel Angelo N.](https://www.office.com/search?q=Navarro%2c+Marcel+Angelo+N.&EntityRepresentationId=c6464783-afc3-4afa-825c-43fcb4a494af), [Chaloner, Isabel](https://www.office.com/search?q=Chaloner%2c+Isabel&EntityRepresentationId=00f4faa0-050a-4d4b-9880-6d9aa4b15b83), [Tsang, Jasmijn](https://www.office.com/search?q=Tsang%2c+Jasmijn&EntityRepresentationId=4c02c6a5-38bd-40a8-9378-35ffab98147a), [Ramachandran, Manikandan](https://www.office.com/search?q=Ramachandran%2c+Manikandan&EntityRepresentationId=ab53e6fe-d92b-4c59-bd50-14111a7f060d), and [Crisostomo, Victor T.](https://www.office.com/search?q=Crisostomo%2c+Victor+T.&EntityRepresentationId=c0b202e9-ee0d-435c-a543-8f5adfae31a7); optional invitees include [Lucy Fu](https://www.office.com/search?q=Lucy+Fu&EntityRepresentationId=6ede0339-cd04-4981-a1f3-6bf772481b29), [Rebecca Jourdan](https://www.office.com/search?q=Rebecca+Jourdan&EntityRepresentationId=18f5fd67-819f-4248-86db-b543d4364d7b), [Lavelle, Tim](https://www.office.com/search?q=Lavelle%2c+Tim&EntityRepresentationId=488f1fe0-33fb-4ab4-894e-9975ee7dca86), [Emma Kirwan](https://www.office.com/search?q=Emma+Kirwan&EntityRepresentationId=3f4610bd-c3ed-4f2f-b315-990a2231f15e), [Dani Rivett](https://www.office.com/search?q=Dani+Rivett&EntityRepresentationId=96ef42b2-8d8e-4bc2-938c-e036c26501f2), [Pagaduan, Jesse C.](https://www.office.com/search?q=Pagaduan%2c+Jesse+C.&EntityRepresentationId=15655688-6c9a-497e-97a1-d6500c999816), and [Cacalda, Hazel Marie](https://www.office.com/search?q=Cacalda%2c+Hazel+Marie&EntityRepresentationId=d1603ce6-a1dc-4b31-979b-29690c1c3ca5).
Your likely contribution
I’d go in ready to be the person who keeps the sizing grounded: call out where FE effort is straightforward, where UI/design maturity affects confidence, and where integration/backend clarification is needed before anyone treats an estimate as firm. That should help the team move through the Must Haves without overcommitting on under-specified tickets.

*Source of truth: Zimmermann Functional Requirements.xlsx, sheet "Returns and Refunds" (RRC). Last updated: 2026-06-19.*

---

## 1. Non-Returnable Products (RRC-001 – RRC-003, confirmed)

- Products can be marked non-returnable at SKU level; categories can be bulk-marked with SKU taking precedence (RRC-001)
- Items ineligible for return: gift cards (physical and virtual); final sale items (clearly flagged). Returnable status does not flip during sales/seasonal campaigns (RRC-001)

- **Non-returnable / final sale indicator** displayed on PDP (RRC-003) — see [pdp.md](pdp.md)

---

## 2. Returns Initiation (RRC-004 – RRC-005, RRC-031, confirmed)

- Returns link shown on order detail in My Account (RRC-004)
- **Domestic** (AU, US, UK, HK) → **redirect** to the **Narvar** returns portal. Returns processing is owned entirely by Narvar; there is no PWA/SFCC build beyond the redirect link (RRC-004; Third-Party Integrations, Returns/Narvar row)
- **International** → **redirect** to the **Global-e** returns portal (RRC-004; Third-Party Integrations, Returns/Global-E row)
- Both registered and guest customers use the same initiation flow: billing email + order number (RRC-005). Identity verification is managed by Narvar and Global-e respectively — no PWA-side verification logic required
- Returns policy link in checkout terms copy opens `/returns` in a new tab (RRC-031)

---

## 3. Returns Page in My Account (RRC-007 – RRC-011, RRC-014, confirmed)

- Dedicated Returns page in My Account showing completed returns only (no in-progress) (RRC-009)
- List view per return: total refund amount, original order ID, return completed date (RRC-010)
- Return Detail page per return (RRC-011)
- **Return history** sourced by calling the MuleSoft `/api/returns` experience API (`GET /api/returns?customer_id=`), which consolidates return data from NewStore OMS (RRC-007)
- **Return status** displayed on the Return History and Return Detail pages, as returned from NewStore via MuleSoft (RRC-008); status retrieved on page load for each return on the Returns page (RRC-014)
- The PWA is a **display surface only** over the MuleSoft `/api/returns` data — per 25.05 comment, "SFCC will only display what returns status is provided by MuleSoft." No PWA-side status derivation or mapping (RRC-007/008/014)
- *Open: Return Detail page must accommodate different taxes/duties per country (RRC-030) — see Open Items*

---

## 4. Cancellation & Order Status (RRC-012 – RRC-018, confirmed)

- Cancelled orders display a distinct **"Cancelled"** status label on Order History page, separate from Returned (RRC-012)
- Cancellation status surfaced on order detail page in My Account once updated by the OMS via MuleSoft (RRC-016)
- BOPIS cancellation status displayed in My Account once cancelled by the OMS (RRC-017)
- Partially cancelled orders (full, individual line item, or partial line item) surfaced in Order History and Order Detail, as returned from NewStore via MuleSoft (RRC-018)
- Order status sourced from NewStore OMS via MuleSoft Experience API (`GET /api/orders?customer_id=`), fetched at page load (RRC-013)
- Refund status: the system does not display refund status directly (RRC-015). A "refund processed" message is acceptable provided it includes a bank processing time caveat — copy managed in Contentful

## 5. Fraud-Flagged Orders (PAY-047 – PAY-051, ready for sign off)

- **No customer-facing communication** while an order is on fraud hold — do not build a fraud hold status display
- No auto-cancellation; no fixed maximum hold duration
- When fraud hold is cleared: NewStore releases the order → SFCC updates order status (customer sees standard "Processing" or equivalent)
- When fraud is rejected: NewStore cancels → Adyen refunds → SFCC updates status to cancelled. Customer sees "Cancelled" per section 4 above
